ops.body: Review context (2026-07-09): the composition still gates on the single global claudeProcessesAlive bool; the 12h cliff also discounts mid_tool/waiting sessions (broader than planned). New plumbing makes the fix easier: nudges now forward the ancestor claude PID AND per-session config roots; BackgroundWorkTracker keys per-session state. E2E item added to observe the remote/cowork host argv (matcher may miss non-claude argv0). See report H/L11/M5.
